text: And for the tent you shall make ten curtains of linen being twined, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, being twined with cherubim. A work of a weaver you shall make them.

The length of the [[2]curtain ; [1]one] shall be eight and twenty cubits; and a breadth of four cubits [[2]to the [4]curtain ; [3]one [1]shall be]. [[3]measure [1]The [2]same] shall be to all the curtains.
And five curtains will be of one another, being held the other with the other. And five curtains will be of one another, being held the other with the other.

And you shall make for them hooks of blue upon the edge of the [[2]curtain ; [1]one], joining; the one part to the coupling. And thus you shall make upon the edge of the [[2]curtain ; [1]outer] for the [[2]coupling ; [1]second].

And fifty hooks you shall make for the [[2]curtain ; [1]one], and fifty hooks you shall make for the part of the curtain corresponding to the coupling of the second, facing headlong into one another each.
And you shall make [[2]hooks [1]fifty] of gold. And you shall join together the curtains one; to the other to the hooks. And [[3]will be [1]the [2]tent] one.
And you shall make hide coverings of hair for protection upon the tent, eleven hide coverings you shall make them.
The length of the [[2]hide covering ; [1]one] will be thirty cubits; and four cubits the breadth of the [[2]hide covering ; [1]one]; [[3]measure [1]the [2]same] will be to the eleven hide coverings.
And you shall join together the five hide coverings to the same, and the six hide coverings to the same. And you shall double up the [[2]hide covering ; [1]sixth] in front of the tent.

And you shall make [[2]hooks [1]fifty] upon the edge of the [[2]hide covering ; [1]one], of the one in the middle by the coupling. And fifty hooks you shall make upon the edge of the hide covering, of the one joining of the second.
And you shall make [[2]hooks [3]of brass [1]fifty]. And you shall join together the hooks by the hooks, and you shall join together the hide coverings, and it shall be one.

And you shall set the extra in the hide coverings of the tent. The half of the hide covering ; being left over you shall cover up for the extra of the hide coverings of the tent. You shall cover up behind the tent.

A cubit from this side, and a cubit from that side; of the superior part of the hide coverings, of the length of the hide coverings of the tent. And it will be to cover up the sides of the tent on this side and that side, that it should be covered.
And you shall make a covering of the tent -- skins of rams dyed red, and coverings of skins of blue on top.
And you shall make posts for the tent from out of [[2]wood [1]incorruptible].
Of ten cubits you shall make the [[2]post ; [1]one], and [[2]cubit [1]one] and a half the width of the [[2]post ; [1]one].
Two joints to the [[2]post ; [1]one] resting headlong against one; to the other. Thus you shall make to all the posts of the tent.
And you shall make the posts for the tent -- twenty posts by the side towards the south.
And forty bases of silver you shall make for the twenty posts. Two bases to the [[2]post ; [1]one] for both ; its parts, and two bases to the other; [[2]post ; [1]one] for both ; its parts.
And the [[2]side ; [1]second] ; towards the north -- twenty posts.
And forty bases for them made of silver. Two bases to the [[2]post ; [1]one] for both ; its parts, and two bases for the other; [[2]post ; [1]one] for both ; its parts.
And by the rear of the tent by the part ; towards the west you shall make six posts.
And two posts you shall make at the corners of the tent at the posteriors.
And they shall be of equal below, and according to the same measurement; they shall be equal from the heads unto [[2]coupling [1]one]. Thus shall you make to both the two corners, let them be equal!
And there shall be eight posts. And ; their bases of silver -- sixteen; and two bases to the [[2]post ; [1]one], and two bases to the other; [[2]post ; [1]one].
And you shall make bars from out of [[2]wood [1]incorruptible]; five to the posts from the one part of the tent.
And five bars to the posts to the [[2]side [3]of the [4]tent ; [1]second], and five bars for the posts on the posterior side of the tent, the one towards the west.
And the [[2]bar ; [1]middle] in between the posts -- let it penetrate from the one side unto the other side!
And the posts you shall gild in gold. And the rings you shall make of gold, into which you shall insert the bars. And you shall gild the bars in gold.
And you shall raise the tent according to the form ; being shown to you in the mountain.
And you shall make a veil from out of blue, and purple, and scarlet being twined, and linen being spun. [[4]work [3]a woven [1]You shall make [2]it] with cherubim.
And you shall place it upon four posts of incorruptible wood; being gilded in gold. And the tips of them in gold, and ; [[3]bases [1]their [2]four] made of silver.

And you shall put the veil upon the posts. And you shall carry in there, inside the veil, the ark of the testimony. And [[3]shall separate [1]the [2]veil] to you between the holy and between the holy of the holies.
And you shall cover up by the veil the ark of the testimony in the holy of the holies.

And you shall put the table outwardly of the veil, and the lamp-stand directly opposite the table near the part of the tent ; towards the south. and the table you shall put by the part of the tent ; towards the north.
And you shall make a draw curtain for the door, of blue and purple, and scarlet being twined, and linen being twined, the work of an embroiderer.
And you shall make for the veil five posts, and you shall gild them with gold; and the tips of them of gold; and you shall cast for them five bases of brass.
